result.title: ProtoEEG: Structured Prototype Alignment for EEG Visual Decoding
result.summary: EEG visual decoding remains difficult because scalp recordings are noisy, spatially coarse, and variable across trials and subjects. Most systems align each trial with a dense image embedding, although that embedding mixes semantic content with instance-specific texture, pose, and background. This target can demand details absent from EEG and provides no explicit account of the visual factors supporting a prediction. We propose \textbf{ProtoEEG}, a prototype-mediated framework that reformulates EEG--image alignment as soft composition over a shared learnable visual codebook. A trainable EEG encoder and a frozen visual teacher produce assignment distributions over the same $K=64$ prototypes. Their weighted reconstructions form a structured representation for retrieval and image generation. Prototype contrast supplies the main cross-modal training signal, distribution alignment coordinates codebook use across modalities, an instance anchor preserves fine-grained discrimination, and diversity regularization prevents redundant prototypes. The shared assignment profile also makes the learned bottleneck directly testable through prototype retention, random selection, and identity shuffling. Across five seeds, ProtoEEG reaches 64.0\% Top-1 and 91.5\% Top-5 on THINGS-EEG2 200-way retrieval. After retraining on EEG-ImageNet, it obtains 44.8\% Top-1 and 73.8\% Top-5 in 80-way retrieval. ProtoEEG also ranks first on all seven reconstruction metrics. Removing prototype contrast lowers Top-1 by 56.9 percentage points, while shuffling prototype identities reduces it to 0.5\%. Prototype analyses further show distributed assignments and broad codebook use rather than one-prototype routing. These results support structured alignment targets as a practical alternative to increasing encoder or teacher capacity alone.

AI.brief_summary: ProtoEEG 提出以共享可学习视觉原型码本为中介的 EEG–图像对齐框架：可训练 EEG 编码器与冻结视觉教师对同一批原型产生分配分布，以原型对比为主要跨模态信号，并配合分布对齐、实例锚定和多样性正则完成检索与图像重建。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享原型瓶颈＋保留/随机选取/身份打乱」的检验方式，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 视觉内容是否被答案真正使用、以及结构化离散状态是否可解释提供可供核查的因果检验线索；但任务本身是脑电解码而非多模态推理。
